title: Page 175
transc:
430 pm to OBrien  Washn Sept 13th 1864
Katy Fever for Knox zebra The Ames shoals I am
under promise to pay or rather to advise paying a
very high price for pekin provided they bear the test
and they are not yet tested zodiac I could not
be justified to pay the extra ordinary price without the
testing I shall be happy to let you have some
of them so soon as I can unity How comes 
on your can all webster Bologna


Washn Sept 13th 1864
845 PM To Beckwith
Rosetta Hudson Crowd Tulip Your recommendation
as to Treasury Inspect or will
be laid before the secret terry
and urged up on him I
agree with you as to the
necessity of the measure yawl Barton


To Beckwith  Washn Sept 14th 1864
Rebecca for Chart tulip If any thing should
require your presence here notice trifle given yard
at present there snow reason to changur plans
EM Stanton
